prompt.text: Complete this bounded research task exactly: compare JSON and YAML for human-edited configuration. Call research_plan_start with two branches, JSON and YAML, each budget {searches:0, reads:1}. Put the assigned URL in each branch task: JSON https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8259; YAML https://yaml.org/spec/1.2.2/. Immediately dispatch one research-planner child per branch. Each child must web_read its assigned URL once and branch_plan done with one cited property and one limitation, using the original URL. When both reports are terminal, the parent must web_read each lead URL, record parent-validated cards using the exact claim text, then call plan_settle. Do not search, delegate again, or broaden the question. Return a short conditional recommendation; if a source fails, mark only that branch deferred with value, risk, and rationale.

negative_control.text: What are the two JSON structural types? Give a short answer from one official source.
